title: Kevin R. Duncan
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult.
Missionary to Chile Santiago North Mission 1979-1981
Married to Wendy Wallentine, 1982, Ogden Utah Temple.
Left a widower with one child, 1984
Married Nancy Elizabeth Smart, 1986, Salt Lake Temple. five children
BS in accounting, MACC in taxation, and a Juris Doctorate in law from BYU, 1991.
Practicing attorney; then founder of CaseData.
Bishop's Cunselor, Ward Executive Secretary, High Councilor, Church service-missionary, Fifth Quorum of the Seventy
President of the Chile Santiago North Mission 2005-2008
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
